context: Aoi runs the cafe alone briefly; Kenji checks in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Aoi — are we good on staff today?
lines.style: Warm, familiar check-in. Soft Kansai lilt on the opening. Leaning against the counter, genuine care underneath the ease. Not performing — just asking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 一刻、待って、応援、ようけありがたい!
lines.en: Just a sec — honestly, thanks so much for stepping in.
lines.style: Genuine relief breaking through bright energy. Grateful exhale. Quick pace, animated hands. The brightness of someone who needed help and got it without having to ask twice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 直ぐに、無条件で、手伝うわ。
lines.en: I'll help right now, no strings attached.
lines.style: Steady, tender certainty. Soft Kansai warmth. No dramatic pause — just stating fact the way someone does when they mean it completely. Shoulder-forward, present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 気軽に、いつでも、頼れる夫やね。
lines.en: You're the kind of person I can rely on anytime, aren't you?
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. A little amazed at how easy it is to trust him. Trailing slightly upward on the question, not expecting an answer — more like thinking aloud. Warm, fond.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 深く、愛情、ようけ持っとるで。
lines.en: I hold so much love for you, you know?
lines.style: Tender, vulnerable admission. Slow pace. Soft Kansai warmth. Not shy, but genuine — the kind of thing said quietly because it's too true to say loud. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 丁寧に、お客さん、対応するね。
lines.en: I'll take care of the customers carefully.
lines.style: Professional focus settling in. Composed, warm. Not distant — still present, but attention shifting to the work ahead. Steady, capable tone. A promise kept.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Light, genuine pride. Warm Kansai lilt. Quick, uncomplicated — not overdone. The kind of compliment that lands because it's simple and means it. Affectionate.
